ingest.note: Streaming endpoint (wss://api.deepgram.com/v1/listen) wants linear16 (16-bit PCM) at the declared sample_rate; 16 kHz mono is the accuracy target. Declare encoding=linear16&sample_rate=16000.

egress.note: Emits partial + final transcripts as JSON, not audio.

potholes.note: Current models: Nova-3 (highest-accuracy general ASR, no native turn detection), Nova-2 (legacy, for languages Nova-3 lacks + filler words), and Flux (newest streaming model WITH native turn detection, built for voice agents). For a cascaded agent, prefer Flux for built-in turn-taking; use Nova-3 when you drive endpointing yourself.
With Nova-3, turn detection relies on endpointing + utterance_end_ms + vad_events. Tune endpointing (ms) vs VAD; too aggressive cuts callers off, too loose adds latency. Flux handles this natively.
Deepgram accepts μ-law directly over the socket, but feeding 16 kHz linear16 after resampling gives materially better accuracy. Prefer PCM.

interruption.description: Deepgram emits SpeechStarted when the user begins speaking. Wire this event to trigger interruption of agent output.
interruption.code_hint: DeepgramSTTService emits speech_started. In Pipecat, this feeds into the interruption pipeline. In custom code, subscribe to SpeechStarted and call your interrupt handler.
